title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash f61c060ecc31… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash f61c060ecc313f9a454f9a1510bab930c6ea89509d5a1bb3b4991a2336acb44b was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. This file was seen 7 times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file is associated with a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security tools for this hash to detect potential compromise.
